description: Source code implementing the BufferD3D class, which provides common functionality for Direct3D buffer management in the ANGLE graphics library, including static/dynamic buffer handling, buffer usage updates, and index range computation.

classes.name: BufferD3D
classes.description: Implements common Direct3D buffer functionality, managing static and dynamic buffers, buffer usage states, and index range calculations.

methods.name: updateSerial
methods.description: Increments the serial number for the buffer instance.

methods.name: updateD3DBufferUsage
methods.description: Sets buffer usage type based on OpenGL buffer usage and initializes static data if needed.

methods.name: initializeStaticData
methods.description: Creates static vertex and index buffers if they do not exist.

methods.name: getStaticVertexBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a static vertex buffer matching specific attribute and binding.

methods.name: invalidateStaticData
methods.description: Clears static buffer caches and resets static buffers, reinitializing if static usage is set.

methods.name: promoteStaticUsage
methods.description: Promotes buffer usage from dynamic to static if enough unmodified data accumulates.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Calculates the index range for a draw call based on buffer data.
